caseNameFull: De Vita v. New Jersey and Grillo v. New Jersey
attorneys: Harry Kay for petitioner in No. 732. George R. Sommer for petitioner in No. 733. Edward Gaulkin and C. William Caruso for respondent.

opinions.text: Supreme Court of New Jersey. Certiorari denied. Mr. Justice Black and Mr. Justice Douglas are of the opinion that the petitions should be granted.
